resources.string: Put each king’s story in order. Tap all six pictures in the order you think the events happened. The badges show your choices from 1 to 6. Use Undo or Reset to change your order before submitting. Each correct position earns one point. After submitting, each card shows + for a correct position or x for an incorrect position. There is no timer. Finish on Sunday to earn 10 XP per correct position; weekday attempts are saved as trials with no XP.
